notes.title: Version 0.8 - What's new?
notes.content: [p][b]🎉 Thank You for 2,000 Wishlists![/b][/p][p]We’re working hard to bring you the Playrooms demo as soon as possible. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]Added Flashlight[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized Camera Effects[/p][/*][*][p]Added First Custom-Made Soundtrack[/p][/*][*][p]UI is now Classic Windows Style[/p][/*][/list][p]If you haven’t wishlisted yet, now’s the perfect time! 💚[/p]
